biography:
A firm believer in 3H philosophy of learning and executing, where my involvement in my research comes from co-ordination and love from Head, Heart and Hands. A computer Science Engineer by profession and a Linguist by hobby, and when I thought of connecting these two incredible fields, I  was able to produce an exciting study on mitigating harmful whatsapp forwards among low-literate population. 
Extending to my work in professional fields, I am a marathon runner and a tennis player, which means that perfection and resilience come hand-in-hand. 
On final note, I love to experiment on things that don't directly belong to my domain expertise like developing a "Sand Battery" in eco-fragile region of Ladakh at Himalayan Institute of Alternatives, Ladakh.
